main_measure.name: OLS slope of drift-removed 48-bar return on forecast, Thursday-23:00 cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting mean > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 cases

supporting_check.name: mean drift-removed 48-bar return in the forecast's direction

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and 2.
reading: Cases are bars starting Thursday 23:00 UTC with a non-zero forecast and a full 48-bar forward return inside their window; the normal drift is the coin's mean 48-bar return on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; the fit has an intercept; fewer than 300 cases is reported as not observable.
